name: Wellhead Control Panel
description: A multi-well hydraulic wellhead control panel described by IPS Group BV operates nine wells (seven installed, two spare) using four pressure levels - 480 bar for SCSSVs, 280 bar for SSVs/SDVs, 150 bar for the field loop and 6 bar control pressure.
aliases: Wellhead Control Panel (WCP), hydraulic SSV/SCSSV actuation with hydraulic power unit (HPU)

specifications.metric: Wellhead control panel (multi-well, hydr — wells controlled
specifications.basis: System designed to operate nine production wells, seven installed and two spare

specifications.metric: Wellhead control panel (multi-well, hydr — VHP header pressure
specifications.basis: 480 bars (VHP header) for the 9 x SCSSV

specifications.metric: Wellhead control panel (multi-well, hydr — MHP header pressure
specifications.basis: 280 bar (MHP header) for the 9 x SSV and 9 x SDV valves

specifications.metric: Wellhead control panel (multi-well, hydr — HP header pressure
specifications.basis: 150 bar (HP header) for field loop of 9 ROCV, 10 ESDV, 14 SDV and 4 BDV

specifications.metric: Wellhead control panel (multi-well, hydr — LP header pressure
specifications.basis: 6 bar (LP header) control pressure, generated by reduction from HP header through two regulators

specifications.metric: Wellhead control panel (multi-well, hydr — VHP accumulator volume
specifications.basis: VHP header equipped with 5 litre bladder accumulators, nitrogen precharge 357.2 bar

specifications.metric: Wellhead control panel (multi-well, hydr — MHP/HP accumulator volume
specifications.basis: MHP header 35 litre bladder accumulators precharge 170.9 bar; HP header 35 litre precharge 98.9 bar

specifications.metric: Wellhead control panel (multi-well, hydr — actuated valve pressure capability
specifications.basis: INTECH modular single and multi-well panels can operate valves of up to 15,000 psi

specifications.metric: Single-well wellhead control panel — wells controlled
specifications.basis: System designed to operate one production well; operates SCSSV, production master valve, production wing valve, choke valve and methanol injection valve
The pre-charge pressure must be checked at least once per year and if necessary charged again
Each pressure level has two dedicated electric driven pumps (A and B)
INTECH panels can be designed for up to 25 years of operational life, with optional extended O&M support
API RP 14C training slides list 'Low pressure hydraulic system' as an input to ESD II
